subject: C
reference_source: Profile design from PKNCA v23-auc-integration-methods vignette; value independently re-derived segment-by-segment below, not by calling PKNCA.
notes: AUClast stops at Tlast=11 (t=12's zero is excluded). Per-segment rule: linear whenever either endpoint is zero or concentration is flat/rising; log only when strictly decreasing with both endpoints positive. Segments: 0-1 linear=0.9, 1-2 linear=0.9, 2-3 linear=0 (both zero), 3-4 linear=1.5 (rising from zero), 4-5 log=(3-2)/ln(3/2)=2.466303, 5-6 linear=2.25 (rising 2->2.5, not log despite both positive), 6-7 linear=1.25 (falls to zero), 7-8 linear=0, 8-9 linear=1.25 (rising from zero), 9-10 log=(2.5-1)/ln(2.5)=1.637035, 10-11 log=(1-0.5)/ln(2)=0.721348. Sum=12.874686. (BioEQ's conc.blq=0 setting treats these zeros as real observed values, not BLQ-dropped - middle zeros stay in the profile rather than being excluded.)
